values.note: NPS: 190 sites, 73 RV-only, 90 tent-only, 27 other; recreation.gov's catalog lists 192 across Loops A-F. The RV loops E (16 sites) and F (46) and tent Loop C were closed throughout October 2026 on recreation.gov; RV and standard sites in Loops A, B and D took bookings. Loop A's RV/standard sites are 15-35 ft except A30, A31 and A34 (64-69 ft); A11 (21 ft) and A25 (23 ft) are back-ins.

sites.source: https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/price-cg.htm ('TOTAL SITES: 190 Electric Hookups: 0 RV Only: 73 Tent Only: 90 ... Other: 27') + recreation.gov campsite catalog and October 2026 availability for 234037, read 2026-10-22

values.note: Recreation.gov: 'Shower house not available in 2026' (the NPS page still lists seasonal hot showers). No cell reception or internet. Firewood sold and staff on site in season; food storage lockers; amphitheater. Non-campers pay $6 for the dump station.

values.note: 2026 season Friday May 22 - Sunday October 25; 'Closed for Winter October 26-May 21'. The Parkway's campgrounds open May through late October, weather permitting; exact dates shift each year.

values.note: Open in 2026 with Loops C, E and F (including the two big RV loops) closed on recreation.gov through October.

values.note: Run by the NPS (not commercially managed). Normally 75 sites are reservable up to six months ahead on recreation.gov or (877) 444-6777 and 115 are first-come, booked in person at the kiosk; but recreation.gov says 'Reservations only. No first come, first served, camping in 2026.' Stay limit 30 consecutive nights and 30 a year. Kiosk open 9:30 am-6 pm in season.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234037 ('In addition to the 75 sites available for advance reservations, 115 sites are available on a first come, first served basis'; notice 'Reservations only. No first come, first served, camping in 2026'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 30, maxStay 30 days Each Year; is_commercially_managed false) + https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/price-cg.htm ('advance reservations can be made for some campsites up to six months in advance'), read 2026-10-22

summary: Open in 2026 (Loops A, B, D; C, E, F closed; no Helene closure). Confirmed $30 all sites and the senior/access 50% discount; added no hookups, 190 sites with pull-throughs, flush toilets/dump/water (shower house closed in 2026), season May 22-Oct 25, recreation.gov booking with 6-month window and 30-night limit (reservations-only in 2026). AWH note left as is (A11 21 ft, A25 23 ft back-ins in Loop A, which is open).
